verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single first-party line saying Elasticsearch combines full-text search, structured filters and aggregations in one engine. Aggregations are the product's own faceting mechanism, but this is a glancing mention. Nothing documents live per-facet counts, range or attribute facets, or getting results and facets back from one query. missing for 10: documentation of facet-count aggregations (terms/range/attribute buckets), evidence that results and facet counts return in a single query, filter-aware live count behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build faceted navigation — filters with live counts across categories, ranges, and attributes — from a single query

citations.quote: Elasticsearch can combine vector search with full-text search, structured filters, aggregations, and hybrid retrieval in one engine
